claim_boundary: These tests are specified but cannot be treated as executed until the named production prerequisites exist and are enabled. Isolated simulation results never auto-close them.

tests.title: Every automated caller routes through one shared compiler
tests.acceptance: Enumerate every production automated caller and prove no feature-local raw-prompt dispatch can reach a provider.

tests.title: Trusted origin and closed-world route enforcement
tests.acceptance: Registered strict automation is enforced, registered Chat lanes are excluded, and unknown/self-asserted/unmigrated origins or routes block.

tests.title: Packet Admission and FileSafe co-bind the exact final request
tests.acceptance: Both independently current receipts bind identical bytes, attachments, route, run, node, attempt, and permission context before dispatch.

tests.title: Late transforms invalidate both program gates
tests.acceptance: Any post-gate prompt, parameter, attachment, route, or serialization mutation blocks and requires a new intent plus both gates.

tests.title: Provider-effective identity and exact-byte attestation
tests.acceptance: Requested and effective provider/model/account/route/effort are preserved; silent substitution or absent attestation is not accepted.

tests.title: Least-authority instruction and capability bundle
tests.acceptance: Only mandatory-global and objective-required components are present, each with identity/version/authority/inclusion reason, and unrelated catalogs are absent.

tests.title: Bounded automated later-turn reconstruction
tests.acceptance: Continuation, compaction, rotation, retry, and resume use current bounded state and never revive stale authority or append the full transcript.

tests.title: Bounded tool and data-result evidence adapter
tests.acceptance: Oversized, partial, prompt-like, secret-bearing, or stale results are retained by governed ref and only bounded current untrusted evidence reaches a model.

tests.title: Response conformance and defect-only repair
tests.acceptance: Malformed, missing/duplicate-ID, evidence-invalid, uncertainty-hiding, forbidden-action, or false-complete output never enters a reducer; repair calls are visible and bounded.

tests.title: Dependency currentness and non-transferable execution authority
tests.acceptance: Changed dependencies invalidate affected descendants; current derivations may be reused as data but old gate/override/dispatch receipts cannot authorize another context.

tests.title: Lossless source and requirement split coverage
tests.acceptance: Every mandatory source span and requirement ID is assigned; any gap, overlap conflict, duplicate, or missing disposition blocks completion.

tests.title: Redundant unstructured extraction and exact-span fidelity
tests.acceptance: New/changed unstructured sources are fully segmented and redundantly extracted; imperative material cannot be downgraded and unresolved meaning remains blocking.

tests.title: Hierarchical reducer completeness and absorbed-suffix accounting
tests.acceptance: Reducers account for every started and absorbed assignment, reject partial/conflicting/unknown-evidence results, and never concatenate raw child transcripts.

tests.title: Planning Wizard and PRD role packet integration
tests.acceptance: Topic, conversion, audit, repair, integration, interview, extraction, and reduction calls all use the shared restrictions with explicit role identity and visible call counts.

tests.title: Goal Runtime role, completion, and repair integration
tests.acceptance: Workers cannot certify completion; planner/evaluator/reducer/verifier/adjudicator/repair/child calls are bounded, current, receipt-linked, and explicit.

tests.title: Orchestrator crew, reviewer, verifier, Overseer, and rollup integration
tests.acceptance: All dispatch, parallel, reviewer, verifier, specialist, Overseer, and parent synthesis calls use stable bounded assignments and lossless result lineage.

tests.title: Executor worker, verification, repair, and retry integration
tests.acceptance: WorkNode dispatch and every review/corroboration/repair/retry attempt uses current immutable packet/permission/provider identity and no stale receipt.

tests.title: Model fallback, reroute, retry, and switch identity
tests.acceptance: Fallbacks and switches remain visible distinct attempts, do not silently replace preregistered subjects, and trigger required packet/currentness checks.

tests.title: Plugin mutation and hook failure enforcement
tests.acceptance: Prompt, parameter, compaction, argument, and result mutations are attributable and rechecked; failure policy cannot create a late unadmitted request.

tests.title: Vision and web research packet/result integration
tests.acceptance: Media/web fan-out, provider fallback, page summaries, citations, OCR, uncertainty, and returned artifacts remain bounded, current, redacted, and route-attested.

tests.title: Automated Testing research, generation, and visual evidence integration
tests.acceptance: Testing research/generation/evaluation uses bounded source-backed packets and produces replayable evidence without model-only or human-eyeballing completion.

tests.title: End-to-end production fleet across every registered automated route
tests.acceptance: Every registered strict-automation route runs the same production packet profile and negative fixtures with raw lineage; unknown routes remain blocked and Chat lanes remain separately verified exclusions.

tests.title: Document-review targeted revision and debug-investigation integration
tests.acceptance: Targeted revision and debug-investigation calls preserve exact anchors, bounded selections, sensitivity labels, omission disclosures, evidence references, and response obligations through final provider bytes and scored output.

tests.title: PlanCompile independent review, audit/repair, certification, and resume integration
tests.acceptance: Independent review, final audit/repair, certification, and resumed reanalysis use bounded current inputs, explicit roles, visible calls, exact evidence lineage, and current non-transferable receipts; stale resume or missing certification remains blocking.
